observations.trace: Both exact current fixture JSON bodies identify dated provenance, a property and placements, finite engineering doorway values, and four or eight geographic triangles. Their notes claim prior controller/clipper acceptance and explicitly limit historical and citywide interpretation. Those are authored claims; neither provenance package nor claimed run transcript is independently established here. Fixture tests read JSON via serde and invoke generation in source only. The production bounded_settlement policy uses fixed typed support and stair constants; the two fixture doorway solutions record grade0.65, displacement6, riser0.19 and minimum going0.25.

observations.trace: SupportCollision explicitly distinguishes Solid from ContactOnly; into_solid returns None for the latter. Enclosure and foundation builders skip zero-volume cells and pass solid parts to native convex_mesh, returning a typed collider error if native construction returns None. The server boundary handler creates and replicates the door/boundary, then inserts a static rigid body only for Some solid. BoundedPropertyTerrain colliders likewise collects an optional foundation solid. The enclosure fixture deliberately asserts ContactOnly for width0 and Solid for width1 and 1e-8, both windings; these source assertions are not executed physics.
observations.remaining: Native convex construction, full consumers, actual supported aggregate enclosure coverage and production reachability remain unresolved; do not turn a legitimate per-cell contact mode into an automatic defect or erase the separate aggregate binding concern.
